data.exact_reserve_text: In 2016, there has been an overall surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 20.1m (2015: GBP 27.1m) due primarily to a reduction in the assessment of medical malpractice claims on the 2013 and prior accounts following lower than expected incurred claims movements during 2016 and a release of catastrophe loads on 2015 year of account as policies come off risk.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Reduction in assessment of medical malpractice claims on the 2013 and prior accounts following lower than expected incurred claims movements during 2016 resulting in a favourable movement (surplus) in ultimate claims.

prior_year_events.event_name: Release of catastrophe loads on 2015 year of account
prior_year_events.impact_description: Release of catastrophe loads as policies come off risk contributing to an overall surplus in ultimate claims.

Syndicate held an expected ultimate gross loss across all years of account of GBP 88.5m (GBP 90.3m last year), of which GBP 69.6m had been incurred at year end; ongoing provisions affected longer-tail settlement expectations.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported an overall favourable prior-year reserve movement in 2016, with a gross surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 20.1m driven mainly by downward reestimation of medical malpractice reserves on 2013-and-prior years and by releases of catastrophe loadings on the 2015 year as policies came off risk. The gross opening claims reserves at 1 January 2016 were GBP 321.0m and the movement represents roughly a 6.3% release of those opening gross claims. The claims development triangle corroborates the surplus, though reinsurance to close and inter-syndicate RITC activity (Syndicate 6103) can affect comparability.
raw_causal_phrases: overall surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 20.1m (2015: GBP 27.1m) due primarily to a reduction in the assessment of medical malpractice claims on the 2013 and prior accounts following lower than expected incurred claims movements during 2016 and a release of catastrophe loads on 2015 year of account as policies come off risk.
The movement in the net provision for claims includes a release of GBP 26.7m in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end as disclosed by segment in note 4 (2015: GBP 17.8m).

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) taken from claims development section: 'overall surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 20.1m'. Per-LOB prior-year figures available in the segmental table are net of reinsurance (used for lob_movements) and therefore are not gross; confidence reduced for LOB splits. Claims development triangle exists but contains an '2010 and prior' aggregate column; aggregate column excluded from triangle-based computations. RITC activity (Syndicate 6103 accepted RITC on 1 Jan 2016) may distort comparability.
